name: How do I identify pillar topics for my business?
description: Identify pillar topics by analyzing audience needs, common questions, and conducting keyword research for broad, high-volume themes relevant to your business.

mainEntity.name: How do I identify pillar topics for my business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Identifying pillar topics involves analyzing your target audience's needs, common questions, and long-tail keywords. Start by brainstorming broad, overarching themes relevant to your business offerings and expertise. Conduct keyword research to identify high-volume, high-relevance terms that can serve as the core of your content strategy. Look for topics that can be broken down into at least 10-20 sub-topics. Your pillar topic should be broad enough to encompass many related articles but specific enough to be distinct from other pillars.
acceptedAnswer.description: Identify pillar topics by analyzing audience needs, common questions, and conducting keyword research for broad, high-volume themes relevant to your business.
